**Starts** once #191 is merged.

## Why

Today the coordinator is sent every tool on our MCP servers that `allowedTools` lets it use. Workers will need tools on the same servers that the coordinator must not see, such as `search_near` on the `places` server. Running the coordinator as a named agent splits the two: the query's options say which tools exist in the session, and the coordinator's definition says which ones it's sent (technical spec 6.5). This is the one part of the worker setup that changes how the app runs today, so it's checked on its own, before any worker exists.

## Design

- [Technical spec](https://github.com/nimbusscale/road-trip-agent/blob/main/design/technical-spec.md), sections 1 (agent types), 2, and 6.5 (the coordinator runs as a named agent).
- [Tool design](https://github.com/nimbusscale/road-trip-agent/blob/main/design/tools.md), section 3 (the coordinator's column).
- [DEVELOPMENT.md](https://github.com/nimbusscale/road-trip-agent/blob/main/DEVELOPMENT.md), section 5 (view files).
- [Research doc](https://github.com/nimbusscale/road-trip-agent/blob/main/research/agent-evaluations.md), section 2.8, for what was checked against Agent SDK 0.3.301.

## Open questions

- None.

## Do

- Run the coordinator as a named agent, as technical spec 6.5 says: `agent: "coordinator"` in the query's options, with its definition in `agents`. The definition's `tools` names each of the coordinator's tools from tool design section 3 that exists today, one by one. Its `prompt` is the coordinator's instructions, the same as the query's `systemPrompt`.
- Leave the query's `tools` empty for now. Worker setup (#198) adds `Agent`, `WebSearch`, and `WebFetch`, and #60 gives the coordinator `Agent(stay-researcher)`.
- Build the coordinator's view file from its definition's tools (DEVELOPMENT.md section 5).

## Done when

- A test shows the coordinator's options name the `coordinator` agent, and that its definition lists the same tools `allowedTools` lets it use today.
- The coordinator's view file shows the same tools as before.
- In a chat with the coordinator, it builds a skeleton for a new trip and reads it back, as before.

## Ends in

A PR.

**Settled in:** chat. Propose each answer to Joe in chat first, and write it in once he agrees.
